products.name: awtab
products.tagline: A whole agent in one browser tab
products.what: One browser tab runs a 1-bit language model on the visitor's GPU through WebGPU, a tool-calling agent loop and an on-device embedder. There is no inference server: the model, the tools and the search all run inside the tab.
products.today: Live in a WebGPU browser at aitherium.com/gobbonet/chat.html. Two model sizes from PrismML's Bonsai family (1.7B and 4B) download once and the browser caches them; the tools run in a worker inside the tab. It has been measured on one GPU class only.
products.planned: Reloading with no network, the smaller 384-d embedder in the tab, and measurements on more than one class of GPU. None of these is done yet. awtab is a page, not a package: nothing by this name is on npm or PyPI.
products.claim: As of 13 November 2026 we found no other browser stack that runs a 1-bit model, a tool-calling agent loop and an on-device embedder together in one tab, with no inference server.
limits: It needs a browser with WebGPU and a GPU it can use.
The first load downloads 248 MB (1.7B) to 572 MB (4B) before the first answer; after that the browser cache serves it.
Search downloads its embedder (the 1024-d one) the first time it is used.
Measured on one GPU class only, and reloading with no network has not been tested.

parts.what: Runs the 1-bit model on the visitor's GPU through WebGPU. Proprietary, and withheld from the public awkit package.
The agent loop in the tab — the model asks for a tool, a worker runs it, the answer goes back to the model.
Turns text into vectors on the visitor's GPU, inside the tab, so search needs no embedding server.
The chat page people open, wired to the model, the tools and the embedder in the tab.
